items.summary: Recommendation: reject the three new fleet proposals this cycle and create no duplicate work. Evidence shows delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, with 170 stranded work items, 108 approved proposals lacking execution, 21 failed requests, and 54 improvements awaiting measurement. Continue existing repair, measurement, readiness, security-evidence, and private-gate work. After CTO resolves or closes the existing saveusfarms.com repair-or-close case and releases one slot, admit only the already-preserved allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement with its existing baseline, validation, measurement window, and rollback. Revenue evidence remains limited to $4.92 aggregate unattributed commission for 2026-09-21; margin, ROI, and causal lift are unknown.
